articles.summary: Note: We wrote most of this update about a month ago, focusing on the first half of the year. We've recently been putting out a lot of new content in response to the fast-changing public sentiment around Hugging Face and existential risk — you can find some of that content on our landing page here, including our most popular video monologue to date. Major updates We're growing our capacity to support our ambition We think 80,000 Hours can deliver significantly more than it does today, so a big theme of the last (and next!) year has been growing our capacity to match those ambitions.
